authorization: 用户：算了，直接重训一个。先完成某一组初始权重Loss的训练，直接后台启动。
scope: one fixed-loss scratch placer; no coefficient search, external solver feedback, corrector training, automatic wakeups, or test evaluation
initialization: all parameters random, seed0, fresh AdamW; no parent weights or state
data: reference_workset_v5 original16k, MIB public mean-area transform E14.mean_area.v1; no new members; validated v6 cache prefix only
precision: FP32, deterministic algorithms, no AMP or numerical-path changes inside run
cublas_workspace_config: :4096:8, set at package import before CUDA initialization
optimizer: AdamW weight_decay0.0003, global gradient clip1; per-module joint proposed-update bound0.005
loss: ten existing terms, fixed E90/E94 F coefficients, shared soft denominator unchanged; explicit vector in loss_config.py
selection: same fixed per-case total for backward/train500/dev500; best, LR and early stop use dev500 arithmetic mean per current protocol; train plateau reported independently, dev early-stop is not proof of train convergence
engine: CPU verified read-only cache, pinned batches, FP32 CUDA graph for model/loss/backward/clip and update projection, AdamW outside graph
network_ports: per-module total weight and weighted centroid only; full port edges used only in loss
stop: STOP file or SIGINT: finish accepted update, save exact latest and exit; no next phase; budget exhaustion distinct from convergence
numerical_guards: nonfinite, per-case loss>=1000, mean loss>=1000 or unclipped gradient norm>=10000 rejected before Adam; no skip or retry
future_weight_learning: not started or authorized by this fixed-baseline run; any later solver feedback train-only
